name: auto-velog
description: Session-driven blog automation for Claude Code — harvest blog-worthy dev experiences from your sessions and auto-publish styled posts to Velog.

plugins.name: auto-velog
plugins.description: Captures ★ BlogWorthy moments (debugging war stories, discoveries, optimizations) during any session, then drafts a human-toned post from the actual transcript, runs a blocking secret/PII scan, and publishes to Velog. Publish mode defaults to approve; fully-automatic mode is opt-in.
